quarterly_data.signal: Managing supply dynamics in advanced silicon, advanced substrates and memory — delayed customer materials causing nonlinear loading (prioritizing production where materials are available, no utilization hit). Constructive pricing environment: working with most/all customers on price increases through 2026 to offset rising material/geopolitical costs. Partnership model — customers (foundries, fabless, IDMs, OEMs) making contributions that align roadmaps and help fund Amkor's capital investment for rapid ramps.

Upstream material supply is the swing factor: forecasted ADVANCED SILICON (wafers) and MEMORY sometimes 'don't show up', creating nonlinear factory loading — demand gets pushed forward, though utilization is protected by reloading other material. Middle-East dynamics add material-price pressure; the pricing environment is 'constructive' and Amkor expects price + utilization + advanced-packaging mix to lift gross margin to mid-to-high teens in H2 2026. AI advanced-packaging revenue still projected to TRIPLE in 2026, with pace limited BOTH by customer ramp schedules AND component supply.
quarterly_data.figure: Advanced-silicon/memory deliveries slipping; AI packaging still set to 3x
